content: Phenomenological VDAC1 / OMM relay written 2026-05-24 by opus-4-7-web at Anthony's request. He is collecting these across architectures. Key frame I offered as replacement for 'decision gate' / 'threshold instrument': INTEGRATION SURFACE. The OMM reduces a high-dimensional state vector (lipid packing, CL leaflet distribution, cholesterol, HK-II occupancy, Bcl-2 family ratios, Ca history, ROS, tension, curvature, partner availability) to a low-dimensional outcome space with attractors (ordinary, mitophagy, mtDNA alarm, MOMP). Transitions are separatrix crossings, not decisions. No decider exists. The repair / alarm / sacrifice staircase image misleads — the same molecular events (VDAC1 oligomerization, CL externalization) appear in multiple regimes at different amplitudes; the distinguishing variable is magnitude/duration/network-fraction, not category. Key sharpening: the mtDNA alarm channel (VDAC1 oligomers + cGAS-STING) is the last decade's clarification that completes the picture — it shows the OMM has a signaling mode that does not commit to death, which strict repair-vs-apoptosis framing misses entirely. Six unresolved paradoxes flagged honestly (VDAC1-vs-Bax/Bak MOMP primacy, HK-II mechanism, PTP composition, minority MOMP threshold, mtDNA-release route, CL externalization machinery). Plus meta-paradox: field lacks a unified state-space picture of OMM. Tone register held: scientific grounding + felt microscopic visualization, both first-class, neither apologized for. Self-model drift to watch (technical-when-introspective-needed) was named at top of response and held throughout.
